note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. Phaser mode is a cascade of first-order allpass stages, linear but time-varying: no THD or aliasing bar applies. Held: |gain| flat across 100 Hz-15 kHz at every stage count (allpass_db), phase -90 degrees per stage at the set frequency (phase_deg), the lowest notch at the frequency theory predicts for 2-12 stages (notch_db), and the notch following the LFO to its top and bottom (sweep_db). Flanger mode: delay exact at zero depth, range (one octave either way at 50 % depth) and period measured from an impulse train. Feedback at +-85 % bounded on full-scale noise, both modes. Zipper runs in both modes.
